sources.title: Lateral excitation of bridges by balancing pedestrians
sources.claim: An inverted-pendulum model of how walkers keep lateral balance: balance is controlled mainly by where the foot is placed, not when; on a swaying deck a walker therefore acts as a negative (or positive) damper even when stepping at a different frequency from the deck, without altering pacing frequency or synchronising; the result is consistent with Arup's empirical model.
